In the name of God, Amen. I Esther Sisco of Kent County State of Delaware being very weak of body but of perfect mind and memory and considering with myself the certainty of Death and the uncertainty of life, I therefore do make and ordain this to be my last will and Testament, in manner following, and first I commend my Soul unto the hands of Almighty God my creator with a sure and certain hope of the Resurrectrion of life at the last day and for my body I recommend to the earth to be buried at the discretion of my Executors herein after named nothing doubting but at the Resurrection I shall receive the same by his Almighty Power and for my worldly Estate I give devise and bequeath unto the persons following and all my lawful debts to be paid first I give unto the persons following all my Personal Estate and four acres and one fourth of an acre to Gelica Lockerman by paying to Susan Derham George Derham's wife this to be paid in four years. I do hereby constitute Gelica Lockerman to be sole Executrix of this my last will and Testament and I do hereby revoke all other wills by me made and I make and declare this only to be my last will and Testament. I Esther Sisco do det my hand and seal this Eleventh day of February in the year of our Lord Eighteen Hundred and fifteen. Signed sealed and delivered by Esther Sisco in the presence of us, John McCoy and John Sanders EASTER (her mark) SISCO
